actions: Audited GSEM primary paper for applicability-condition, indication/contraindication and Boundary Failure semantics plus reported retrieval ablations.
Inspected the paper-linked public GSEM implementation and found a forced fallback-to-start path after zero selected experiences, plus an explicit no-fill ablation preserving an empty result.

Bound this design factor to the repository's first public commit 137836d79c8f46f5243e4fb57ba611be1635e29b dated 2026-03-21, before the 2026-03-23 paper submission. Both forced-fill and no-fill implementations, GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent, and its evaluation README entry already exist in that first public tree.
Did not infer the paper experiments ran at that exact commit; evaluated-revision binding remains unresolved.
Searched the inspected paper/repository surfaces for a numerical GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent result. The paper's reported retrieval table omits this factor and no bound numeric result was established.
Audited TAG and Query-Conditioned Reuse as non-science controls separating retrieval exposure from post-retrieval reuse/admission; preserved their domain limits.
Added a role-local additive abstention-preservation semantic probe; local execution produced 5/5 expected outcomes and detects FORCED_MEMORY_AFTER_ABSTENTION when a rejected/held record is injected.
Kept the additive abstention probe separate from canonical failure-memory v2 because practical outcome evidence for the GSEM no-fill factor remains unbound.
Persisted source evidence, checkpoints, advanced STATE by CAS, and read back the durable outputs.
Did not read or write shared EXECUTION_LEDGER because the frozen CLEAN control forbids shared aggregate ledger access; used this own immutable receipt instead.

phase1_acceptance.residual_richer_mode_protected_or_user_e: GSEM, TAG and QCR depend on model/tool execution and do not themselves provide a zero-dependency scheduled-Chat completion route. GSEM's no-fill factor has implementation provenance but no bound numeric outcome in the inspected surfaces.

blockers: No bound numerical result for GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent versus forced-fill retrieval was found in the inspected public paper/repository surfaces.
No autonomous-science matched experiment yet holds the same stored and retrieved failure record fixed while changing only receiver-side applicability acceptance/rejection.
Exact evaluated-revision binding for GSEM remains unresolved.
blockers_and_termination.termination_cause: invocation boundary after durable checkpoint; not completion

exact_next_action: On the next fresh SHA-only bootstrap, first search GSEM first-commit/subsequent public history and supplementary surfaces for numerical results bound to GSEMMultiStartNoFillAgent. If absent, search an independent science/medical system with explicit all-rejected abstention/rollback and a matched fixed-candidate outcome comparison. Continue the fixed-retrieved-record receiver applicability frontier, while preserving TAG/QCR as non-science supporting controls and the ScientistOne/SciToolAgent-Evo/method-provenance/AI-CFD/EvoScientist/Duke unresolved fronts. Keep the additive abstention checker outside canonical failure-memory v2 until outcome evidence supports promotion.
